description: This file defines a set of PHP classes for handling iCalendar components such as VCALENDAR, VEVENT, VTODO, VALARM, and VTIMEZONE. It provides methods for constructing, validating, serializing, and managing calendar data, including support for properties, subcomponents, and specific calendar functionalities like attendee management and date formatting.

classes.name: iCalendar_component
classes.description: Base class for iCalendar components providing common functionality for properties and subcomponents management, validation, and serialization.

classes.name: iCalendar
classes.description: Represents the top-level VCALENDAR component with specific properties and support for nested components.

classes.name: iCalendar_event
classes.description: Represents the VEVENT component with specific properties, validation, and methods for event-specific data handling.

classes.name: iCalendar_todo
classes.description: Represents the VTODO component, managing task-related properties and validation.

classes.name: iCalendar_alarm
classes.description: Represents the VALARM component, managing alarm properties and trigger calculations.

classes.name: iCalendar_timezone
classes.description: Represents the VTIMEZONE component, managing timezone properties.

methods.name: iCalendar_component::add_property
methods.description: Adds a property to the component, handling validation, default values, and invariants.

methods.name: iCalendar_component::add_component
methods.description: Adds a subcomponent if it is valid.

methods.name: iCalendar_component::is_valid
methods.description: Validates the component and its subcomponents and properties.

methods.name: iCalendar_component::serialize
methods.description: Serializes the component to iCalendar format if valid.

methods.name: iCalendar_event_dtstamp
methods.description: Sets the DTSTAMP property based on activity data.

methods.name: iCalendar_event_dtstart
methods.description: Sets the DTSTART property based on activity start date and time.

methods.name: iCalendar_event_dtend
methods.description: Sets the DTEND property based on activity due date/time.

methods.name: iCalendar_event_attendee
methods.description: Populates attendee list from activity data by querying invitees.
